# 4 Ezra Chapter 6 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** Core apocalypse — Third vision

---

**1** And he said to me: At the beginning of the circle of the earth, before the gates of the world were set in place, and before the assembled winds blew,

**2** and before the voices of thunder sounded, and before the flashes of lightning shone, and before the foundations of paradise were laid,

**3** and before the beautiful flowers were seen, and before the powers of motion were established, and before the innumerable hosts of angels were gathered,

**4** and before the heights of the air were lifted up, and before the measures of the firmaments were named, and before the footstool of Zion was established,

**5** and before the present years were reckoned, and before the imaginations of those who now sin were estranged, and before those who stored up faith for a treasure were sealed —

**6** then I considered these things, and they all were made through me and through no other; as also the end shall come through me and through no other.

**7** Then I answered and said: What will be the division of the times? Or when will the end of the first age come, and the beginning of the age that follows?

**8** And he said to me: From Abraham to Isaac, when Jacob and Esau were born of him, Jacob's hand held from the beginning the heel of Esau.

**9** For Esau is the end of this age, and Jacob is the beginning of the age that follows.

**10** The hand of a man is between the heel and the hand; seek no other answer, Ezra.

**11** I answered and said: O LORD, my lord, if I have found grace in your eyes,

**12** I pray you, show your servant the end of your signs, of which you showed me a part on the previous night.

**13** And he answered and said to me: Rise upon your feet and you will hear a full resonant voice.

**14** And if the place where you stand is greatly shaken,

**15** fear not when it speaks; for the speech is about the end, and the foundations of the earth shall understand

**16** that the speech is about them: they shall tremble and be shaken; for they know that their end must be changed.

**17** And it came to pass when I heard it, I stood upon my feet and listened, and behold, a voice was speaking, and its sound was like the sound of many waters.

**18** And it said: Behold, the days come, and it shall be when I begin to draw near to visit the inhabitants of the earth,

**19** and when I begin to make inquisition of those who have done wrong with iniquity, and when the humiliation of Zion shall be complete,

**20** and when the seal shall be set upon the age which is about to pass away — then will I show these signs:

**21** the books shall be opened before the face of the firmament, and all shall see them together;

**22** and children of one year old shall speak with their voices, and pregnant women shall bring forth untimely children at three and four months, and these shall live and spring up.

**23** And suddenly the sown places shall appear unsown, and the full storehouses shall suddenly be found empty;

**24** and the trumpet shall sound aloud, and when all hear it, they shall suddenly be terrified.

**25** At that time friends shall fight one against another like enemies, and the earth shall stand in fear together with its inhabitants, because of the powers of thunder.

**26** And after these things, if the Most High grants me to live, I will tell you the things I shall see; and the disorder of the nations shall be in the hand of the Most High.

**27** Then I answered and said: In every instance, O LORD, what I ask is this: why have I been given the power of understanding?

**28** For it was not in my mind to inquire about the ways above, but about those things we daily experience: why is Israel made a reproach before the Gentiles, why is the people you loved given over to blasphemous nations, why is the law of our fathers become as nothing, and the written covenants come to nothing?

**29** We pass through the world like grasshoppers, and our life is a thing of wonder and terror; and we are not worthy to obtain mercy.

**30** But what shall he do for his name that is called over us? Of these things I ask.

**31** Then he answered me and said: The more you search, the more you shall marvel; for the world hastens swiftly to pass away,

**32** and is unable to comprehend the things promised to the righteous in the time to come; for this age is full of sorrow and infirmities.

**33** For the evil that has been sown among us has not yet borne complete fruit; and the field where evil was sown has not yet come to perfect harvest.

**34** And unless the evil is fully reaped where it was sown, the field of the one who sows good cannot come.

**35** For a grain of evil seed was sown in the heart of Adam from the beginning — how much impiety has it brought forth until now, and how much more shall it bring forth until the threshing floor comes!

**36** Reckon now for yourself how great a harvest of iniquity a single grain of evil seed has produced.

**37** When the countless ears shall have been cut off, how great a threshing floor shall they fill!

**38** Then I answered and said: How long? When will these things be? Why are our years few and evil?

**39** And he answered me and said: Do not hasten beyond the Most High; for you are eager only for yourself, but the Most High is eager for many.

**40** Were not the souls of the righteous asking the same things in their treasuries: When shall I receive my fruit, O LORD? When shall the threshing come?

**41** And the archangel Jeremiel answered them: When the number of those like you shall be complete; for he has weighed the world in a balance.

**42** By measure he has measured the times, and by number he has numbered the seasons; and he shall not move nor stir things until the appointed measure is fulfilled.

**43** Then I answered and said: O LORD who art above us, we know all this; but behold, we who are to be saved, and who shall be saved through your ways — when shall we come to the inheritance you have promised us?

**44** And he answered me and said: You shall receive it when the number previously spoken of is fulfilled; for the Most High has made this age for many, but the world to come for few.

**45** But I will tell you a parable, Ezra: as when you ask the earth, she will say that she yields much clay from which earthen vessels are made, but little dust from which gold comes — so also is the course of this age.

**46** I answered and said: Could you not have created at once those who have been and who are and who shall be, so that you might show your judgment the sooner?

**47** Then he answered and said: The creature cannot hurry beyond the Creator; neither can the world hold at one time all those who shall be created in it.

**48** Then I said: How then has it been spoken to your servant that you will make alive at once all your creatures — that those kept in the earth, and those in forgotten places, and those who dwelt in the sea, shall come back together?

**49** And he said: Signs shall be given; when the womb that has been closed shall open, and that which has been kept in it shall be brought forth — for a child cannot be kept unless there is a vessel to hold him.

**50** And since you have asked me about fire and wind and the day, behold I say to you:

**51** As three streams mingle together the waters of great rivers to make one river, so shall many signs be shown to those who dwell upon the earth at the last.

**52** Then I answered and said: Lord God, you showed me signs on the previous night, though you did not show me all.

**53** Tell me now: when will this land you spoke of be desolate?

**54** And he said: When I arise to execute judgment upon the earth, then shall come the liberation of the righteous, and the end of the works of the wicked.

**55** The sun shall not shine upon the people who have forsaken my covenant, nor shall the light of the moon illuminate them.

**56** The lightning shall not appear to them, neither shall the radiance of the stars shine upon them; but only darkness and terrible visions shall appear to them.

**57** But to the righteous there shall be the light of the sun seven times as bright.

**58** And I said: O LORD, you showed me this land; and the Most High made this age for many, but the age to come only for few:

**59** Shall we then not enjoy it?
